plugins.description: Smart textbook authoring team: 13-state pipeline orchestration covering instructional design, retrieval, writing, review, and delivery with anti-hallucination citation verification. v2.0: ACP envelope alignment across members. v2.1: task-router routing + trace/progress observability. v2.6: section-level wave state persistence + contract write-back + lead verdict gate. v2.9: exercise-marker canonical form. v2.10: three-level team collapse (chapter/section/block) + section-level review loop (review-section) + reasoning-chain envelope fields (21) + tool orchestration SSOT table + std-skill local anchor form ④. v2.17: +3 optional-enhancement members (learner-advocate / standards-alignment / assessment-designer), 22 task_types. v2.18: W1 runbook (three optional members fixed spawn points: standards-parse at Phase A, learner trial-read after R2, assessment at ASSEMBLE) + router eval 47→61 samples. v2.18.1: W2/W5 member mounting clauses + markdown link validity gate (check_md_links.py wired into CI + run_all, 12 positive/negative tests). v2.18.2: internal harness testing — router fuzz fix (assessment-review false-route) + install-state archive exclusion + host cache restore. v2.19.0: full retest closed loop — 13 defects fixed (2 concurrency BLOCKERs: e3_window circuit + trace bad-line silent drop), runtime-state dirs declared, watchdog/progress/rejects semantics hardened.
